description: When you need to find drift between declared code/config and observed behavior, return ranked divergences: missing edges, version or host mismatches, compatibility violations, symbol/field mismatches, and observed failures. Each result carries confidence and severity; use this for a broad audit before choosing a specific failing node.

minConfidence.description: Drop divergences below this confidence threshold (0.0 - 1.0).

node.description: Scope to divergences involving this node id (as source or target).

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

type.description: Filter by divergence type. One or more of: missing-observed, missing-extracted, version-mismatch, host-mismatch, compat-violation, observed-symbol-mismatch, observed-failing. Omit for all.

name: get_divergences
